title: MUG500+ · author-cleaned A0101 skull

space.name: Original MUG500+ A0101 author-cleaned mesh coordinates
space.reference: Original A0101_clear.stl facet coordinates from the pinned healthy A0101 archive; no project transform other than identity metric scaling.
space.correspondence: Author-cleaned source surface. Original CT intensities are absent; no cross-source MRI alignment or newly rasterized segmentation is asserted. Original noisy binary sections remain a separate source package.
space.unit_basis: The primary Methods describe STL surfaces extracted from the corresponding original segmentation in millimeter sampling. Same-case original STL declares SPACE=RAS; direct source-mesh coordinate comparison is retained in config/mug500-source-mesh-verification.json. The independent viewer does not assign anatomical axis labels.

sources.title: MUG500+ healthy skull A0101
sources.citation: Li J et al. MUG500+: Database of 500 high-resolution healthy human skulls and 29 craniotomy skulls and implants. Data in Brief 39:107524 (2021). doi:10.1016/j.dib.2021.107524. Only healthy skull A0101 is used. Dataset doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.9616319.v20.

model_evidence: Original author-cleaned skull surface from the source-designated healthy A0101 segmentation. Source authors removed most noise, artifacts and non-skull structures; no project cleanup is applied.
model_notes: The primary paper distinguishes Axxxx_clear.stl from the original noisier Axxxx.stl and binary NRRD; these representations are not interchangeable.

The project preserves every supplied clear-STL triangle coordinate and winding. Exact duplicate vertices are indexed without tolerance; no smoothing, hole filling, component deletion, decimation or anatomical registration is performed.
Source cleanup can remove structures and alter surface completeness. Fine foramina, thin walls, anatomical normal variants and original CT correspondence require separate evidence and review.
The rejected MUG-20261013-01 image pair concerns the original noisy binary-mask package. This distinct surface needs its own assessment.
scope_notes: Independent source-cleaned 3D mesh; no original CT image, new 2D mask, named bone or foraminal segmentation.
Source geometry and authorship are preserved; engineering validation does not establish anatomical teaching suitability.

teaching_sequences.title: Author-cleaned whole-skull context
teaching_sequences.objective: Explore the original author-cleaned skull surface with explicit source-processing limits.
teaching_sequences.instruction: Rotate the complete skull, inspect the internal surface with clipping, and compare source processing with the separate original binary-mask package. This is a source surface without original CT intensity.
teaching_sequences.evidence_limit: No named bone or foraminal boundaries; no new normal-variant labels. Author cleanup is distinguished from project processing and requires separate teaching assessment.
teaching_sequences.step_prompt: Inspect the supplied cleaned surface and identify where interpretation would require original CT or explicit anatomical labels.
teaching_sequences.step_question: Which aspects of this view are supplied source geometry, and which anatomical conclusions remain unsupported?

acquisition: Reuse the existing pinned A0101-A0105 archive. Extract only the author-supplied A0101_clear.stl; retain original NRRD and rejected review images unchanged.
